name: contact
description: Accessible contact form with honest status codes, honeypot, time trap, rate limit, body cap, optional Cloudflare Turnstile, local draft, retry with email fallback and a Workers send_email endpoint. Long multi-section forms: add the contact-intake template (handler only; shared parsing helpers ship here).
next: Merge wrangler.contact.snippet.toml (the send_email binding and a verified sender) into wrangler.toml: node -e "console.log(require('fs').readFileSync('Web_Toolkit/templates/contact/wrangler.contact.snippet.toml','utf8'))"
Add /api/contact to crawlerDisallow in the discovery site-config.ts.
Local runs: copy .dev.vars.example to .dev.vars (Turnstile test keys work on localhost only).
Check the result: node Web_Toolkit/form_doctor/bin/form-doctor.mjs run --project-root . --spawn (after a build).
